text:
B: Hiya! Oh, there's your dog, I can see the ear. That's so cute.
A: *(laughs)* Hiya. Yeah, that's Dolly. She won't get off me.
B: I'm Aleena, I'm in Swansea. Not Cardiff.
A: Gemma. Walsall. Erm, I wouldn't have said Cardiff.
B: Everyone does, it's my thing now. Have you had Ryan yet? The Manchester one?
A: No. I've had... Craig, and Gareth.
B: Oh my god, he's so loud. He's nice, though. He told me recruitment was soul-destroying and I was like, you don't even know me. *(laughs)* So what do you do?
A: I run a shift. At a parcel depot. Off the M6.
B: Wait, parcels? Like Evri and stuff?
A: Sort of, yeah. Couriers, that kind of thing.
B: Stop. I sell on Vinted. I'm probably sending you stuff every week. Do you see the parcels, like, actually?
A: *(laughs)* Erm, thousands of them, yeah. They come off the belt and the lads scan them. What do you send?
B: Trainers, mostly. Clothes. I sold some Air Forces last week for double what I paid.
A: Double? That's good, that.
B: I know! So if a box of trainers goes missing, that's you, yeah?
A: *(laughs)* It's not me, I promise. Usually it's a label that won't scan. You'd be surprised how many people write the postcode wrong.
B: People are actually so stupid. Sorry, no, that's mean. Some people are.
A: No, to be fair, some of them are. *(laughs)* Erm, are you at uni, then?
B: First year, Business Management. And I work Saturdays in a sports shop. I'm the top seller on add-ons, socks and that.
A: Socks. *(laughs)* I always get talked into socks.
B: That's me. I'm the one doing it to you. Do you like your job, though?
A: Erm. Most days. I started on the belt at nineteen, scanning, and just sort of worked up. I'm not really a manager, do you know what I mean, I just run a shift.
B: No, that's literally a manager though. How many people?
A: About forty.
B: Forty! That's more than my whole shop. You should be saying that, not "I just run a shift". If I had forty people I'd be telling everyone.
A: *(laughs)* I can tell.
B: Rude! *(laughs)* No, but true. Do you have, like, holidays and stuff? Where do you go?
A: Erm, Tenerife usually. Quiet all-inclusive. Booked last minute 'cause we never get round to it.
B: I did Tenerife after A-levels with the girls! Not quiet, though. I want Ibiza next summer.
A: I get stressed in the airport. I print everything out and then I lose it.
B: Just put it on your phone. Sorry, that's obvious.
A: Craig says that. My husband. I still print it.
B: That's actually kind of sweet, ngl. Do you have kids, or—
A: Erm, no. Not yet. Just Dolly.
B: Dolly's enough, look at her. Is she—
